literature.role: Real 2012 four-photon delayed-choice entanglement swapping with earlier Alice/Bob registration and later Victor QRNG choice and measurement
Theoretical NSC vs NSS separation and hypothetical postquantum jamming capability, not a physically established resource

physical_hypotheses.standard_QM: P(X,Z|do(B=SSM))=P(X,Z|do(B=BSM)) for the complete earlier unconditional record
physical_hypotheses.alternative: Later physical free setting B changes an earlier complete joint distribution, even while each early local marginal remains independent of B
physical_hypotheses.separate_conditional_quantum_effect: P(X,Z|B,V) may differ strongly across the later measurement results V in standard QM, without signalling to earlier time

hardware_components: Two sources or a suitably characterized four-photon state preparation
Separate early single-photon detector stations Alice and Bob with raw time-tagging including missing clicks
Late Victor measurement selectable between Bell-state and separable-state analysis
Independent audited QRNG physically located with Victor, with real late bit timing
Independent hardware or tamper-evident time-taggers for early detectors and late QRNG/measurement
Predeclared trial triggers retained even for no-clicks, losses, herald failures and aborted attempts
practical_setup.time_order: For every trial, t_early_X and t_early_Z must precede the actual entropy-production, choice activation and measurement of Victor B and V, within certified apparatus uncertainties
practical_setup.hardware_sealing_constraint: Ma 2012 nanosecond-scale delays cannot be sealed online by GitHub or ordinary internet. Use independently audited hardware time-tagging/append-only electronics, or a substantially longer physical quantum delay and authenticated external seal. GitHub Actions may analyze AFTER the run, not certify nanosecond event chronology.
practical_setup.confidentiality: No early raw record, detector state, future RNG seed or its controller can access future B before physically later choice
practical_setup.QRNG_assumptions: Physically trusted choice generation, no common deterministic seed or controller crosstalk between early detectors and B
practical_setup.quantum_mechanism_limit: The published Ma-type arrangement is standard quantum mechanics and itself predicts no difference in unconditional early joint probabilities. A distinct physical resource would be required for the stronger jamming hypothesis.

planned_analysis.primary_effect: Total variation between the full nine-category P(X,Z|B=SSM) and P(X,Z|B=BSM), including NO_CLICK and all scheduled trials
planned_analysis.primary_null: Later independent B labels are exchangeable relative to fixed earlier pair (X,Z) categories under no intervention effect
secondary_checks: Coincidence/heralded P(X,Z|B,V) as explicitly SECONDARY postselected quantum prediction, not primary
planned_analysis.predeclaration: Alpha, N, outcome mapping and permutation count must be physically frozen before collecting the future-choice data
planned_analysis.synthetic_positive_control: Future B injected BEFORE early X,Z generation. This verifies the CPU statistic can detect a large dependence but cannot prove a backward-time channel.
